fullDescription: Trust-forward testimonial section in a fresh emerald-on-white palette: a centered heading ('It's not just us saying it.' with an emerald gradient tail), an emerald eyebrow pill, a 4.9 / 2,300+ five-star rating strip, and a responsive 1/2/3-column grid of six testimonial cards (oversized serif quote marks, emerald-ring avatars, brand logos) over a masked emerald dotted field, with one inverted emerald-700 featured card and a six-logo trust strip. Inter + Georgia quote marks, Phosphor + simple-icons via Iconify.
prompt:
## Resumo
A clean, trust-forward testimonial section in a fresh emerald-on-white palette for a prompt-to-UI design product. Above a subtly dotted, emerald-washed backdrop sits a centered heading block: a rounded emerald eyebrow pill ('Words from the makers'), an extrabold Inter headline 'It's not just us saying it.' with the last two words in an emerald gradient, a muted-slate subhead, and a five-star + '4.9 average across 2,300+ reviews' rating strip. Below is a responsive 1/2/3-column grid of six testimonial cards (figure/blockquote/figcaption), each opening with an oversized serif quotation mark, a builder quote, and a footer with an avatar (emerald ring), name, role, and a brand lockup (Iconify simple-icons logo + company name). The third card is a featured variant flipped to a solid emerald-700 ground with white text and a soft blurred glow. The section closes with a 'Trusted by teams shipping at' caption above a six-logo emerald brand strip. A sticky blurred white nav sits on top. Inter throughout, Georgia for the quote marks, Phosphor + simple-icons via Iconify.

## Estilo Visual
Design a fresh, trust-forward SaaS testimonial section in a single emerald accent on crisp white, using Inter for all UI text (weights 400/500/600/700/800; tight -0.01 to -0.02em tracking; headline extrabold 800) and Georgia serif only for oversized decorative quotation marks. Palette: white background #ffffff; ink/slate scale ink-900 #0b1220, ink-800 #1e293b, ink-700 #334155, ink-600 #475569, ink-500 #64748b, ink-400 #94a3b8, ink-200 #e2e8f0, ink-100 #f1f5f9, ink-50 #f8fafc; emerald scale emerald-50 #ecfdf5, emerald-100 #d1fae5, emerald-500 #10b981, emerald-600 #059669, emerald-700 #047857. Section backdrop = white with a faint dotted field (radial-gradient(circle at 1px 1px, rgba(16,185,129,0.10) 1px, transparent 0) at 26px tile) masked with radial-gradient(120% 80% at 50% 0%, black, transparent 75%) so it fades out, plus a soft top wash (linear-gradient(to bottom, emerald-50/80, transparent) over the top ~288px). Default cards: white rounded-2xl, 1px ink-200 border, p-7, near-flat shadow 0 1px 2px rgba(15,23,42,0.04); on hover lift translateY(-4px) (transition cubic-bezier(.16,.84,.44,1)), border to emerald-200, shadow to 0 18px 40px -22px rgba(16,185,129,0.45). One featured card inverts to a solid emerald-700 ground/border with white text, a soft blurred emerald-500/40 glow blob, and a stronger emerald drop shadow. Use a 6xl Georgia quotation mark in emerald-200 (white/35 on the featured card) at the top of each card, slightly negative-margined into the quote. Accent everything in emerald only: the eyebrow pill (emerald-50 fill, emerald-100 border, emerald-700 uppercase wide-tracked label), the gradient headline tail (bg-clip-text emerald-600 to emerald-500), five emerald-500 stars, emerald-100 avatar rings, and an emerald-600 six-logo strip. Icons via Iconify: Phosphor ph:* for UI glyphs and simple-icons:* for brand logos. Keep it clean, premium and trustworthy, never flat or generic.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Sticky nav
A sticky top header (z-50) with a translucent white background (white/85) + backdrop blur and a 1px ink-200/70 bottom border. Inside a max-w-7xl row, h-16, items justify-between, px-6 / lg:px-8: left = a logo lockup = a rounded-lg emerald-500 tile (h-8 w-8, soft emerald shadow) holding a white Phosphor ph:sparkle-fill icon, beside an extrabold tracking-tight ink-900 'Palette' wordmark; center = medium ink-600 nav links (Library, Canvas, Pricing) that darken to ink-900 on hover plus a semibold emerald-700 'Stories' link, hidden below md; right = a 'Sign in' ghost link (ink-600, hidden below sm), a solid pill 'Start free' button (rounded-full, ink-900 fill, white text, hover ink-800) with a ph:arrow-right-bold icon that nudges right on hover, and a hamburger icon button (ph:list-bold) shown only below md.

### Heading block
A centered heading block capped at max-w-3xl. (1) An eyebrow pill: an inline-flex rounded-full chip with an emerald-50 fill, emerald-100 border, px-3.5 py-1.5, holding a small ph:chats-circle-fill icon and an uppercase wide-tracked (0.14em) emerald-700 label 'Words from the makers'. (2) An extrabold Inter headline (mt-6, text-4xl -> sm:text-5xl, leading ~1.08, tight tracking, ink-900) reading 'It's not just us saying it.' where the words 'saying it.' are a separate span with an emerald-600 -> emerald-500 bg-clip-text gradient (block on mobile, inline on sm+). (3) A muted subhead paragraph (mt-5, max-w-xl, text-lg, leading-relaxed, ink-500): 'Thousands of builders go from a one-line prompt to a shippable interface on Palette. Here's what a few of them had to say.'. (4) A centered rating strip (mt-7, flex, gap-3): five emerald-500 ph:star-fill icons next to a small ink-500 label '4.9 average across 2,300+ reviews' with '4.9' and '2,300+' bolded in ink-800.

### Testimonial grid
A responsive testimonial grid (mt-16, grid-cols-1 -> md:grid-cols-2 -> lg:grid-cols-3, gap-6 / lg:gap-7) of six figure cards. Default card = a flex-col white rounded-2xl figure with a 1px ink-200 border, p-7, near-flat shadow, hover-lift (-4px) to an emerald-200 border + emerald-tinted glow shadow. Each card stacks: an oversized 6xl Georgia quotation mark in emerald-200 (group-hover emerald-300), slightly negative-margined; a blockquote at ~15.5px leading-relaxed in ink-700; then a figcaption (mt-6, flex items-center gap-3.5, top 1px ink-100 border, pt-5) = an 11x11 rounded-full avatar with a 2px emerald-100 ring on the left, a min-w-0 flex-1 block with a bold ink-900 name + a medium ink-500 role, and on the right a small brand lockup = a simple-icons logo + a semibold ink-600 company name. Six entries: Maya Okonkwo / Founding Designer / Northwind (simple-icons:vercel); Daniel Reyes / Staff Engineer / Cadence (simple-icons:linear); Priya Nadkarni / Indie Hacker / Shipfast (simple-icons:railway, FEATURED); Sofia Bergstrom / Product Lead / Lumen (simple-icons:figma); Marcus Lindqvist / Design Manager / Pageworks (simple-icons:notion); Aisha Rahman / Co-founder & CEO / Tideflow (simple-icons:supabase). Quotes are about going from a one-line prompt to shippable UI, wiring the design skill into a coding agent, the infinite canvas, the prompt library, and shipping a marketing site over a weekend.

### Featured (emerald) card
The third card is a featured variant: a relative overflow-hidden rounded-2xl figure with a solid emerald-700 ground and border, p-7, and a stronger emerald drop shadow (0 18px 44px -20px rgba(16,185,129,0.6)). It carries a pointer-events-none blurred glow blob (an absolutely-positioned -right-10 -top-10 h-32 w-32 rounded-full emerald-500/40 with blur-2xl) in the corner. The quote mark is white/35; the blockquote text is white and font-medium; the figcaption border is white/20, the avatar ring is white/40, the name is white, the role is white/90, and the brand lockup (simple-icons:railway 'Shipfast') is white/90. Quote: 'I'm a developer, not a designer, and Palette is the first tool that made my side projects look like a real company built them. The prompt library alone is worth it.'

### Closing logo strip
A closing trust block (mt-16, top 1px ink-200 border, pt-10). A centered uppercase wide-tracked (0.18em) ink-500 caption 'Trusted by teams shipping at'. Below (mt-6) a centered flex-wrap row (gap-x-10 gap-y-6) of six emerald-600 brand logos via Iconify simple-icons (vercel, linear, figma, notion, railway, supabase) at width 26, each darkening to emerald-700 on hover.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Componente
Masked emerald dotted field: a full-bleed absolute background of radial-gradient dots (circle at 1px 1px, rgba(16,185,129,0.10) 1px, transparent 0) on a 26px tile, masked with radial-gradient(120% 80% at 50% 0%, black, transparent 75%) so it fades toward the bottom (pointer-events none)

### Componente
Soft emerald top wash: an absolute inset-x-0 top-0 h-72 linear-gradient(to bottom, emerald-50/80, transparent) layered behind the heading

### Componente
Emerald eyebrow pill: a rounded-full emerald-50 chip with an emerald-100 border holding a ph:chats-circle-fill icon and an uppercase wide-tracked emerald-700 label

### Componente
Gradient headline tail: the closing words wrapped in a span with an emerald-600 -> emerald-500 bg-clip-text text-transparent gradient

### Componente
Rating strip: five emerald-500 ph:star-fill icons beside a '4.9 average across 2,300+ reviews' label with the figures bolded

### Componente
Hover-lift testimonial card: white rounded-2xl figure with a near-flat shadow that, on hover, translateY(-4px) (cubic-bezier(.16,.84,.44,1)), gains an emerald-200 border and an emerald-tinted glow shadow (0 18px 40px -22px rgba(16,185,129,0.45))

### Componente
Featured emerald card: a solid emerald-700 inverted card variant with white text, a white/35 quote mark, white/20 figcaption hairline, a white/40 avatar ring, a blurred emerald-500/40 corner glow blob, and a stronger emerald drop shadow

### Componente
Oversized serif quote mark: a 6xl Georgia opening-quote glyph in emerald-200 (white/35 on featured), negative-margined into the top of each card

### Componente
Card byline lockup: an emerald-ring avatar + bold name + role on the left, a simple-icons brand logo + semibold company name on the right, separated by a top hairline border

### Componente
Six-logo emerald trust strip: a wrap of simple-icons brand logos (vercel, linear, figma, notion, railway, supabase) in emerald-600, darkening on hover

### Componente
Sticky blurred white nav: a translucent white/85 header with backdrop blur and an ink-200/70 bottom hairline border

### Componente
Iconify icons throughout: Phosphor ph:sparkle-fill / ph:chats-circle-fill / ph:star-fill / ph:arrow-right-bold / ph:list-bold for UI, and simple-icons:* for brand logos

## Notas Especiais
Font: Inter only for all UI text (Google Fonts, weights 400/500/600/700/800), with tight tracking and an extrabold (800) headline + bold (700) names; Georgia (serif) is used only for the oversized decorative quotation marks (.quote-mark). Styled with Tailwind via CDN using a custom theme palette: ink 900 #0b1220 / 800 #1e293b / 700 #334155 / 600 #475569 / 500 #64748b / 400 #94a3b8 / 200 #e2e8f0 / 100 #f1f5f9 / 50 #f8fafc, and emerald 50 #ecfdf5 / 100 #d1fae5 / 500 #10b981 / 600 #059669 / 700 #047857. Body background is white with antialiased font smoothing; html has scroll-behavior:smooth. Icons via Iconify (ph:* Phosphor for UI glyphs, simple-icons:* for brand logos). The signature moves are the masked emerald dotted field + soft top wash backdrop, the editorial oversized serif quote marks, the hover-lift cards with emerald glow, and the single inverted emerald-700 featured card that anchors the grid. Keep the palette a single emerald scale over white, never introduce a second hue.
